title: Alpenwert Outdoor Water Filter — up to 4000 Litres, only 97 g, for Camping
short_description: Compact outdoor water filter by Alpenwert with activated carbon, carabiner and carrying strap — only 97 g, for camping and hiking.
long_description: The Alpenwert outdoor water filter (model ALPENWERT-OTW-1) is rated for a capacity of up to 4000 litres according to Amazon and uses activated carbon. It is 19 cm long, about 3 cm in diameter and weighs 97 g. The maximum TDS level is stated as 1000 ppm. According to Amazon the box contains the water filter, a carabiner and a carrying strap. Before buying, please read the manufacturer's information on water treatment and use on the Amazon product page carefully.
features: Capacity up to 4000 litres (according to Amazon)
buying_angle: Handy for campers and hikers looking for a lightweight filter system for the trail who want to check the manufacturer's details before buying.
